class_name UnitToken
extends Node2D
## UnitToken — one drawn unit on the board (v1: code-drawn, no textures).
## Doctrine: READ-ONLY view of a sim unit Dictionary. The token never mutates
## sim state; the battle view owns all writes. Séance palette, 32px cells.
## Ghost tokens (ghost=true) render as translucent echoes: pale blue (echo 0)
## or deep violet (echo 1+), with a slow spectral flicker (view-only, cheap).

const BODY: float = 22.0
const BODY_HALF: float = 11.0

const COL_PLAYER := Color("d8b45a")      # candle gold — the living
const COL_ENEMY := Color("b04848")       # ember red — the shades
const COL_GHOST_0 := Color("9fb7e8")     # séance blue-white — echo 1
const COL_GHOST_1 := Color("8a6fd0")    # deep violet — echo 2
const COL_TEXT := Color("e8e2d4")
const COL_PIP := Color("ffffff")
const COL_SELECT := Color("ffffff")

var unit: Dictionary = {}
var selected: bool = false

func setup(u: Dictionary) -> void:
	unit = u
	selected = false
	# Ghost flicker: only ghosts pay for _process (no empty _process on living tokens).
	set_process(bool(u.get("ghost", false)))
	queue_redraw()

func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	queue_redraw()

func _draw() -> void:
	if unit.is_empty() or not bool(unit["alive"]):
		return
	var is_ghost: bool = bool(unit.get("ghost", false))
	var body_col: Color = COL_ENEMY if String(unit.get("faction", "player")) == "enemy" else COL_PLAYER
	var alpha: float = 1.0
	if is_ghost:
		var echo_index: int = int(unit.get("echo", 0))
		body_col = COL_GHOST_1 if echo_index >= 1 else COL_GHOST_0
		# Slow spectral flicker, deterministic-safe (TIME-based view garnish only).
		alpha = 0.62 + 0.10 * sin(Time.get_ticks_msec() / 420.0)
	# Body: rounded square, centered on the cell.
	draw_rect(Rect2(-BODY_HALF, -BODY_HALF, BODY, BODY), Color(body_col, alpha), true)
	# Glyph: first letter of unit type (L/M/S lineholder/marksman/skirmisher...).
	var glyph: String = String(unit.get("type", "?")).substr(0, 1).to_upper()
	var font := ThemeDB.fallback_font
	var ts := font.get_string_size(glyph, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, -1, 12)
	font.draw_string(get_canvas_item(), Vector2(-ts.x / 2.0, 4.0), glyph,
		HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, -1, 12, Color(COL_TEXT, alpha))
	# HP pips: one tiny bar per hp, across the bottom of the body.
	var hp: int = int(unit["hp"])
	var pip_w: float = BODY / 10.0
	for i in range(hp):
		var px: float = -BODY_HALF + 1.5 + i * pip_w
		draw_rect(Rect2(px, BODY_HALF - 4.0, pip_w - 1.0, 2.0), Color(COL_PIP, alpha), true)
	# Selection ring for the currently selected unit.
	if selected:
		draw_rect(Rect2(-BODY_HALF - 3.0, -BODY_HALF - 3.0, BODY + 6.0, BODY + 6.0),
			Color(COL_SELECT, 0.9), false, 1.5)
